newsitem.title: ESTONIA: Estonia Union Bank makes 57 mln kroon '96 profit.
newsitem.headline: Estonia Union Bank makes 57 mln kroon '96 profit.

text.p: Key Estonian bank Union Bank said on Monday that its 1996 net profit was 57.17 million kroons versus 35.32 million kroons in 1995.
The bank earlier announced that it is to merge with the country's fifth largest bank, North Estonian Bank, to become what will be the second bank in the Baltic state.
Union Bank also said in its earnings statement that its assets grew to 3.62 billion kroons in 1996 from 2.63 billion at the end of 1995.
The bank said that deposits were 2.23 billion kroons versus 1.49 billion at the end of 1995.
Total shareholder equity at the end of 1996 was 350 million kroons versus 188 million kroons at the end of 1995.
Union Bank was the third-largest Estonian bank before the merger with North Estonian.
It was the first of the commercial banks, which dominate the Tallinn stock exchange, to release its 1996 earnings.
Union Bank, like leading commercial bank Hansapank, is quoted both in Tallinn and Helsinki.
